amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ሰራዊት ከቅርብ ጊዜ ወዲህ በታኢዝ ግዛት በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ የአየር እና የምድር ጥቃቶችን አጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል። መንግስት ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደው የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ቁልፍ ቦታዎችን መቆጣጠራቸውን ተከትሎ የጠፉ ግዛቶችን ለማስመለስ ነው። ከሀምሌ ወር ጀምሮ በተቀሰቀሰው ግጭት ከ130,000 በላይ ሰዎች ከቀያቸው የተፈናቀሉ ሲሆን የሰብአዊ ቀውሱም አሳሳቢ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yemen naannoo Ta’izitti garee Huutii irratti haleellaa qilleensaafi lafaa cimaa gaggeessaa jiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame erga gareen Huutii lafa tarsiimawaa ta’e tokko to’annaa isaa jala oolchee booda kanneen dhabaman deebisanii qabachuufi. Waraana Ji'a Adooleessaa irraa kaasee dhalateen namoonni kuma 130 ol ta’an buqqa’anii jiru, kunis rakkoo namoomaa cimaa uumee jira.

title: Plane carrying DR Congo military delegation crashes
english: A military aircraft recently crashed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, resulting in the deaths of 17 individuals. The victims included four civilians and two high-ranking military officials who were part of an official delegation. Authorities are currently looking into the circumstances to determine what caused the accident.
amharic: በዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ የጦር ኃይሎች ልዑካን ቡድን የያዘ አውሮፕላን ተከስክሶ አስራ ሰባት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በአደጋው ህይወታቸው ካለፈው መካከል አራት ሲቪሎች እና ሁለት ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ መኮንኖች ይገኙበታል። ባለስልጣናት የአደጋውን መንስኤ ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Xiyyaarri ergamtoota waraanaa Rippabiliika Dimookiraatawaa Koongoo fe'ee deemaa ture tokko kufee namootni 17 lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Miidhamtoota kana keessaa namootni siivilii afur fi ajajoonni waraanaa olaanoo lama kan argaman yoo ta'u, aangawonni sababa kuffatii xiyyaarichaa irratti qorannoo gaggeessaa jiru.

title: Malaysia’s Ng, Sivasangari book LA28 Olympics berth with Asian Games gold
english: Malaysian squash players Eain Yow Ng and Sivasangari Subramaniam have become the first athletes to secure spots in the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. By winning gold medals at the Asian Games in Japan, the pair earned automatic qualification for the sport's debut in the Olympic program. Both champions successfully defended their Asian Games titles with dominant performances against their Indian opponents.
amharic: የማሌዢያው የስኳሽ ተጫዋቾች ኢይን ያው ንግ እና ሲቫሳንጋሪ ሱብራማኒያም በ2028 የሎስ አንጀለስ ኦሊምፒክ ላይ ለመሳተፍ የመጀመሪያዎቹ አትሌቶች ሆነዋል። በጃፓን በተካሄደው የእስያ ጨዋታዎች የወርቅ ሜዳሊያ በማሸነፋቸው፣ ስኳሽ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በኦሊምፒክ ፕሮግራም ሲካተት በራስ-ሰር ለመወዳደር ብቁ ሆነዋል። ሁለቱም አሸናፊዎች በህንድ አቻዎቻቸው ላይ ጠንካራ ብቃታቸውን በማሳየት የዋንጫ ክብራቸውን በተሳካ ሁኔታ አስከብረዋል።
oromo: Atileetonni isquashii biyya Maleeshiyaa Eain Yow Ng fi Sivasangari Subramaniam, ispoortii isquashii jalqabaaf sagantaa Olompikii irratti yeroo hirmaatu, Olompikii Los Angeles 2028 irratti hirmaachuuf qulquloofatan. Atileetonni kun tapha 'Asian Games' Jaappanitti gaggeeffame irratti meedaaliyaa warqee fudhachuun isaanii, carraa Olompikii irratti hirmaachuu isaanii mirkaneesseef. Atileetonni kunneen morkattoota isaanii kan Hindii injifachuun, qophii isaan godhataniin sadarkaa isaanii ittisuu danda'aniiru.

title: Huge crowds cheer Pope Leo as he leads open-air Mass in Paris
english: Pope Leo XIV recently held a massive outdoor Mass at the Place de la Concorde in Paris, which was attended by approximately 800,000 people. This event was a central part of his official visit to France. Additionally, the Pope traveled to Lourdes to participate in prayers with thousands of faithful followers at the Grotto of Massabielle.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ በፓሪስ ፕላስ ደ ላ ኮንኮርድ በተካሄደው የሜዳ ላይ መስዋዕተ ቅዳሴ ላይ ወደ 800,000 የሚጠጉ ምዕመናንን ሰብስበዋል። ይህ ዝግጅት ለፈረንሳይ ጉብኝታቸው ትልቅ አካል ነበር። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም ሊቀ ጳጳሳቱ ወደ ሉርድ በመጓዝ በማሳቤል ዋሻ ውስጥ ከሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ አማኞች ጋር በጋራ ጸልየዋል።
oromo: Paphaasii Leo XIV, Paarisitti bakka 'Place de la Concorde' jedhamuutti qilleensa banamaa keessatti qulqulluu qiddasee kan geggeessan yoo ta'u, namoonni 800,000 ol ta'an hirmaataniiru. Ayyaanni kun daawwannaa isaanii kan Faransaay keessatti bakka guddaa qaba. Akkasumas, paphaasichi gara magaalatti Lourdes imaluun, bakka 'Grotto of Massabielle' jedhamutti namoota kumaatamaan lakka'aman wajjin kadhannaa gaggeessaniiru.

title: Ethiopia’s army promises restraint amid fears of new civil war
english: The Ethiopian military reports it is handling recent outbreaks of violence in the northern regions with caution to avoid a full-scale civil war. The Army Chief of Staff accused Eritrea of backing rebel factions, a claim Eritrea has denied, while both the government and Tigrayan forces report significant ongoing clashes. These developments have caused global concern, as they severely threaten the stability of the 2022 peace agreement.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ መከላከያ ሠራዊት በሰሜን ኢትዮጵያ የተቀሰቀሰውን ግጭት አገሪቱን ወደ አዲስ የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት እንዳይመራ በጥንቃቄ እየያዘው መሆኑን አስታውቋል። የጦር ኃይሎች ጠቅላይ ኤታማዦር ሹም ኤርትራ ታጣቂዎችን ትረዳለች ሲሉ የከሰሱ ሲሆን፣ ኤርትራ ግን ይህንን አስተባብላለች። በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል እየተካሄደ ያለው ተደጋጋሚ ግጭት በ2014 ዓ.ም የተፈረመውን የሰላም ስምምነት አደጋ ላይ ጥሎታል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Itoophiyaa naannoo kaabaatti lola ka’e gara waraana biyyaatti akka hin geessine of eeggannoon akka hojjechaa jiru ibseera. Ajajaan waraanaa mootummaan Ertiraa garee finxaaleyyiif deeggarsa akka gootu himus, Ertiraan himannaa kana haalteetti. Walitti bu’iinsi kunis waliigaltee nageenyaa bara 2022 irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumee jira.

title: Detained Tunisian flotilla activists: Worsening health amid family anguish
english: Four Tunisian activists associated with the Sumud Flotilla are currently being held in detention, where they face severe health complications and physical deterioration. Their families are suffering deeply, with children experiencing emotional trauma and distress due to the prolonged separation from their fathers. Despite their precarious situation, loved ones continue to advocate for their release while sharing stories of the activists' past heroism and commitment to social justice.
amharic: የሱሙድ ፍሎቲላ አባል የሆኑ አራት የቱኒዚያ አክቲቪስቶች በእስር ላይ የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት የጤና ሁኔታቸው በጣም እያሽቆለቆለ ይገኛል። ቤተሰቦቻቸውም ከሚወዳቸው ሰዎች በመለየታቸው ከፍተኛ የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ እና ስቃይ እየደረሰባቸው ሲሆን በተለይም ልጆቻቸው ላይ የሚታየው ተጽእኖ ከፍተኛ ነው። እነዚህ ቤተሰቦች የአክቲቪስቶቹን መፈታት እየጠየቁ ስለ እነርሱ የቀድሞ በጎ ተግባራት እና ለፍትህ ያላቸውን ቁርጠኝነት በመመስከር ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni fi duuka buutonni Sumud Flotilla kan ta'an lammiileen Tunisiyaa afur hidhaa keessa jiru, yeroo ammaa kana fayyaan isaanii baay'ee gadadaa jira. Maatiin isaanii fi ijoolleen isaanii fira isaanii irraa adda ba'uu irraa kan ka'e rakkoo cimaa fi miira qaamaa keessa jiru. Maatiin hidhamtoota kanaa hidhamtootni kun mirgaaf qabsaa'ota akka ta'an dubbatuu fi akka gadi lakkifaman gaafachaa jiru.

title: German, Russian foreign ministers hold rare talks amid rising tensions
english: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul and Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov held rare, high-level discussions in New York on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. Their meeting, the first since the 2022 invasion of Ukraine, focused on easing regional tensions and addressing issues like Black Sea grain exports. Despite the dialogue, Lavrov dismissed German concerns about escalation, and both nations remain deeply divided over the ongoing conflict and recent security incidents.
amharic: የጀርመን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ዮሃን ዋዴፉል እና የሩሲያው አቻቸው ሰርጌይ ላቭሮቭ በተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ጎን ለጎን በኒውዮርክ ያልተለመደ የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይት አድርገዋል። ከ2022 የዩክሬን ጦርነት በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በተደረገው በዚህ ስብሰባ፣ ሁለቱ ወገኖች በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት ስለማርገብ እና በጥቁር ባህር በኩል ስለሚካሄድ የእህል ንግድ ተወያይተዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ውይይቱ ቢኖርም፣ ላቭሮቭ የጀርመንን ስጋት ውድቅ ያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለው የፖለቲካ ልዩነት አሁንም እንደቀጠለ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Jarman Johann Wadephul fi ministirri dhimma alaa Raashiya Sergey Lavrov qarqara walgahii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaa irratti magaala New Yorkitti marii kan taasisan yoo ta'u, kunis marii dhimma alaa idilee keessatti kan hin beekamneedha. Mariin kun waraana Uukreen bara 2022 eegale booda kan jalqabaa yoo ta'u, mariin isaaniis dhiphina naannoo sanaa hir'isuu fi dhimma ergaa midhaan biqiltuu galaana gurraacha irratti kan xiyyeeffatedha. Haa ta'u malee, marii kana keessatti Lavrov yaaddoo Jarmanin ka'e fudhatama dhabsiisuun, walitti dhufeenyi biyyoota lamaanii dhimmoota waraanaa fi nageenyaa irratti ammas wal-dhabdee cimaa akka qaban agarsiiseera.

title: Bangkok declared disaster zone after heavy rains submerge roads
english: Bangkok has been officially designated a disaster area following intense rainfall that caused severe flooding across the city. The extreme weather overwhelmed local drainage systems and canals after some areas received up to 300 millimeters of water. Authorities are currently dealing with submerged roads and the significant impact these floods have had on the capital's infrastructure.
amharic: ባንኮክ በጣለባት ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት ከተማዋ በጎርፍ በመጥለቅለቋ መንግስት የአደጋ ቀጠና ሆና እንድትታወጅ አድርጓል። በአንዳንድ የከተማዋ አካባቢዎች እስከ 300 ሚሊሜትር የሚደርስ ዝናብ በመዝነቡ የፍሳሽ ማስወገጃዎች እና ቦዮች አቅም በላይ ሆነዋል። ይህ ከባድ ዝናብ መንገዶችን በማጥለቅለቁ ለከተማዋ መሠረተ ልማት ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አስከትሏል።
oromo: Roobni cimaan guyyoota darban magaalattiitti roobee ture lolaa guddaa waan uumeef, Baangkookiin naannoo balaa mudate jedhamee labsameera. Roobni hamma millimeetira 300 gahu bakka tokko tokkotti roobuu isaa hordofee, sirni bishaan gadi dhiisuu magaalaattii guutummaatti cufameera. Lolaa kanaanis daandiileen gurguddoon bishaaniin liqimfamuun tajaajila adda kutaniiru.

title: A FIRE LIT FOR PEACE, IN THE RAIN
english: Thousands of people gathered at Meskel Square in Addis Ababa for the traditional Demera bonfire celebration despite heavy rain. This year's festival emphasized themes of national reconciliation and unity amid ongoing political and ethnic tensions in Ethiopia. Religious and government leaders used the event to call for forgiveness, patience, and a collective commitment to lasting peace across the country.
amharic: በአዲስ አበባ መስቀል አደባባይ በዝናብ ታጅቦ የተከበረው የደመራ በዓል በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ምዕመናን ተገኝተዋል። የዘንድሮው በዓል በኢትዮጵያ ያለውን የፖለቲካና የብሄር ግጭቶች ለመፍታት የሚያስችል የሰላምና የአንድነት መልዕክት ላይ ትኩረት አድርጓል። የመንግስትና የሃይማኖት መሪዎች ህዝቡ ልዩነቶችን በመተው በትዕግስትና በይቅርታ ለዘላቂ ሰላም እንዲቆም ጥሪ አስተላልፈዋል።
oromo: Ayyaanni Dameraa guyyaa kaleessaa bakka bu'oota amantii kumaatamaan lakka'amaniin magaalaa Finfinnee, masqala Isquwaariitti, roobaa cimaa keessatti kabajameera. Ayyaanni kun yeroo kanatti biyyattii keessatti rakkoolee siyaasaa fi sanyiin wal qabatan jiran furuuf, tokkummaa fi nagaa irratti xiyyeeffateera. Hogganoonni amantii fi mootummaa, uummanni garaagarummaa isaa dagatee, dhiifamaa fi obsaan nagaa biyyattii akka mirkaneessu dhaamaniiru.

title: A Holiday Homecoming Buckles Under Rising Bus Fares
english: Rising bus fares are making it increasingly difficult for many people to travel home for the Meskel holiday. While many remain determined to visit their families, the high costs are forcing them to travel in smaller groups, bring fewer gifts, or cancel their plans entirely. This financial strain is changing the traditional experience of holiday reunions for many families.
amharic: የአውቶቡስ ትኬት ዋጋ መወደድ ለመስቀል በዓል ወደ ቤተሰቦቻቸው ለመጓዝ ለሚፈልጉ ሰዎች ከፍተኛ ፈተና ሆኗል። ብዙዎች በዓሉን ከቤተሰቦቻቸው ጋር ለማሳለፍ ቢፈልጉም፣ በዋጋ ጭማሪው ምክንያት በቡድን ከመጓዝ ይልቅ በተናጠል ለመሄድ፣ ስጦታዎችን ለመቀነስ ወይም ጉዞአቸውን ሙሉ በሙሉ ለመሰረዝ ተገደዋል። ይህ የኑሮ ጫና የባህላዊ በዓል አከባበርን እና የቤተሰብ መገናኘትን መንገድ እየቀየረው ይገኛል።
oromo: Gatiin konkolaataa dabaluun namoota baay'ee ayyaana Masqalaatiif gara maatii isaanii deemuuf carraaqan irratti gufuu ta'eera. Hedduun isaanii maatii isaanii wajjin ayyaaneeffachuuf fedhii qabaatanis, gatii meeshaalee fi imala qaaliin ta'e irraa kan ka'e, namoonni baay'een imala isaanii haquuf ykn kennaa xiqqoo qabatanii deemuu dirqamaniiru. Kuni imala ayyaanaatiin wal-qunnamuun aadaa ture irratti jijjiirama fiduu qabatee jira.

title: Fed Pours Billions into Cheap Fuel the IMF Says It Should Drop
english: The International Monetary Fund has urged the Ethiopian government to eliminate broad fuel subsidies once global market prices stabilize. While the government is currently capping subsidy costs and supporting state importers, the IMF argues that ending these payments will improve financial stability. Phasing out this aid is intended to redirect public funds toward more productive national development projects.
amharic: የዓለም የገንዘብ ድርጅት (IMF) ዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ሲረጋጋ ኢትዮጵያ በነዳጅ ላይ የምታደርገውን ሰፊ ድጎማ እንድታቆም መክሯል። መንግሥት በአሁኑ ወቅት የድጎማ ወጪዎችን በመገደብ እና ለነዳጅ አስመጪ ድርጅቶች ድጋፍ በማድረግ ላይ ቢገኝም፣ ድርጅቱ ይህ ድጋፍ የሀገሪቱን የፋይናንስ አቅም ለማጠናከር መቋረጥ አለበት ብሏል። ይህ እርምጃ ለልማት ስራዎች የሚውል በጀት ለመቆጠብ እንደሚያስችልም ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mallaqa Addunyaa (IMF) gatiin boba'aa gabaa addunyaa irratti yeroo tasgabbaa'u, mootummaan Itoophiyaa gargaarsa gatii boba'aa bal'inaan kennamu dhaabuu akka qabu gorseera. Mootummaan ammaaf baasii gargaarsaa muruufi dhaabbilee boba'aa gurguddaaf deeggarsa gochuuf yaalii gochaa jiraatus, IMF akka jedhutti deeggarsa kana dhaabuun dhaabbata maallaqaa biyyattii cimsuuf barbaachisaadha. Tarkaanfiin kun qabeenya mootummaa hojiiwwan misooma biyyaaf oolchuuf gargaara.

title: Banks Baulk at a Bill from Public ID That Turns Commercial
english: FaydaVerse, the state-run entity managing Ethiopia's digital ID system, has started demanding fees from commercial banks for identity verification services that were previously provided at no cost. The company claims these charges are necessary to ensure its financial sustainability as a state-owned enterprise. In response, banking institutions are strongly opposing the new contractual requirements for these authentication checks.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያን ዲጂታል መታወቂያ ሥርዓት የሚያስተዳድረው ፋይዳቨርስ (FaydaVerse) ለንግድ ባንኮች ከዚህ ቀደም በነፃ ይሰጥ የነበረውን የማንነት ማረጋገጫ አገልግሎት አሁን በክፍያ እንዲፈጽሙ እየጠየቀ ነው። ድርጅቱ ይህ ውሳኔ የፋይናንስ አቅሙን ለማጠናከር እና ሥራውን ለማስቀጠል አስፈላጊ እንደሆነ ይገልጻል። የንግድ ባንኮች በበኩላቸው በአዲሱ የክፍያ ስምምነት ላይ ጠንካራ ተቃውሞ እያሰሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hojjettoota sirna eenyummaa dijitaalaa Itoophiyaa kan ta'e FaydaVerse, tajaajila eenyummaa mirkaneessuu kan kanaan dura baasii malee kennamaa tureef, amma baankota irraa kaffaltii gaafachuu jalqabeera. Dhaabbatichi kaffaltiin kun hojii isaa itti fufsiisuuf akka barbaachisu ibseera. Baankonni daldalaa garuu, kaffaltii haaraa fi waliigaltee dhiyaate kana cimsee mormaa jira.

title: Ethiopia Nears a WTO Seat It May Struggle to Cash In
english: Ethiopia is approaching the final stages of its long-term efforts to become a member of the World Trade Organization. While this move aims to boost international trade, experts suggest the country may face significant challenges in fully leveraging the benefits of membership. Successful integration will depend on the government's ability to modernize its economy and navigate complex global market requirements.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ ለረጅም ጊዜ ስትጥርበት የነበረውን የአለም የንግድ ድርጅት አባልነት የመጨረሻ ምዕራፍ ላይ ደርሳለች። ይህ እርምጃ ዓለም አቀፍ ንግድን ለማሳደግ ያለመ ቢሆንም፣ ሀገሪቱ ከአባልነቷ ሙሉ በሙሉ ተጠቃሚ ለመሆን ትልቅ ፈተናዎች ሊገጥሟት እንደሚችሉ ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ። ስኬታማ የንግድ ውህደት የተመሰረተው መንግስት ኢኮኖሚውን ዘመናዊ ለማድረግ እና ውስብስብ የሆኑ የአለም ገበያ መስፈርቶችን ለማሟላት በሚያደርገው ጥረት ላይ ነው።
oromo: Itoophiyaan miseensa Dhaabbata Daldalaa Addunyaa ta'uuf carraaqqii dheeraa gochaa turte gara xumuraatti geessiseetti. Tarkaanfiin kun daldala idil-addunyaa gabbisuuf kan karoorfame ta'us, biyyattiin fayyadamoo ta'uuf rakkoolee hedduu akka qabdu ogeeyyonni ni himu. Milkaa'inni Itoophiyaa guddina diinagdee ishee ammayyeessuu fi gabaa addunyaa waliin walitti makamuuf dandeettii ishee irratti kan hundaa'e ta'a.

title: Iran war live: Tehran awaits official response as Trump rejects Hormuz plan
english: The Iranian government is currently waiting for a formal response from the United States regarding a proposed plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. President Donald Trump has officially rejected Iran's seven-day roadmap, stating that the proposal is not acceptable to his administration. Consequently, Iranian officials have expressed deep skepticism about the value of continuing future diplomatic negotiations with Washington.
amharic: የኢራን መንግሥት የሆርሙዝ የባህር በርን እንደገና ለመክፈት ያቀረበው ዕቅድ ላይ ከአሜሪካ ይፋዊ ምላሽ እየጠበቀ ይገኛል። የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የኢራንን የሰባት ቀን የሥራ ዕቅድ ተቀባይነት እንደሌለው በመግለጽ ውድቅ አድርገውታል። በዚህም የተነሳ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ከዋሽንግተን ጋር በሚደረጉ ድርድሮች ላይ ያላቸው እምነት እንደቀነሰ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Iran karaa galaana Hormuz banuuf karoorashee erga dhiyeessitee booda, deebii semaata ta'e mootummaa Ameerikaa irraa eeggachaa jirti. Prezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp karoora guyyaa torbaa Iran dhiyeessite kan hin fudhatamne ta'uu ibsuun kufaa godhaniiru. Haaluma kanaan, hoggantoonni Iran marii gara fuulduraa kan Waashingitan waliin taasisan irratti amantaa akka hin qabne beeksisaniiru.

title: Pezeshkian says Iran ‘no longer trusts talks with Washington’
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has stated that Tehran has lost faith in diplomatic discussions with the United States due to past instances of sanctions and military aggression. This declaration follows a rejected Iranian proposal regarding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Consequently, current tensions between the two nations remain high as dialogue efforts appear to be stalled.
amharic: የኢራን ፕሬዝዳንት ማሱድ ፔዜሽኪያን ካለፉት ማዕቀቦች እና ጥቃቶች በኋላ ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ጋር በሚደረግ ድርድር ላይ እምነት እንደሌላቸው ገልጸዋል። ይህ አስተያየት የተሰጠው ኢራን የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን እንደገና ለመክፈት ያቀረበችውን ሃሳብ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ውድቅ ካደረጉ በኋላ ነው። በዚህም ሳቢያ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ውጥረት በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeshkian akka jedhanitti, Iraan dararamaa fi kanaan dura tarkaaffiiwwan dippiloomaasii booda haala irra turtee fi cinaatti dhiibbaa diinagdee ishee irra ga'een booda, marii Waashingitan waliin taasifamu irratti amantii akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Ibsi kun kan kenname Donald Traamp dhiyeessiin Iraan daandii galaana Hormuz banuuf dhiyeessite erga didanii booda. Haala kanaan, walitti dhufeenyi biyyoota lamaanii gidduu jiru hammaatee kan itti fufe yoo ta'u, mariin dippiloomaasii akka dhaabate mul'ata.

title: Four American tourists among 6 killed in suspected gas leak blast in Athens
english: A massive explosion, likely triggered by a gas leak, destroyed a two-story building in the historic Plaka district of Athens, resulting in six deaths. The victims include four American tourists and an elderly couple who lived on the premises. Local residents had previously warned authorities about potential gas safety issues in the area, and emergency crews are currently assessing the structural stability of nearby buildings.
amharic: በአቴንስ ታሪካዊው የፕላካ ሰፈር በጋዝ መፍሰስ ምክንያት በተከሰተ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታ የአንድ ባለ ሁለት ፎቅ ሕንፃ በመፍረሱ ስድስት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል አራቱ አሜሪካውያን ቱሪስቶች ሲሆኑ ቀሪዎቹ ደግሞ በዚያው ሕንፃ ውስጥ ይኖሩ የነበሩ አረጋውያን ጥንዶች ናቸው። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ቀደም ብለው ስለ ጋዝ መፍሰስ ስጋት ለባለሥልጣናት ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተው እንደነበር የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ አሁን የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች በአካባቢው ያሉ ሌሎች ሕንፃዎችን ደህንነት በመገምገም ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Atensiitti naannoo seena-qabeessa Pilaakaatti dhoohiinsa gaazii irraa ka'e jedhamee shakkamuun mana darbii lamaa diigamee lubbuun namoota jahaa darbeera. Miidhamtoota kana keessaa afur tuuristoota Ameerikaa yoo ta'an, lama immoo namoota achuma mana sana keessa jiraachaa turani. Jiraattonni naannichaa dhoohiinsi kun osoo hin ta'in dura waa'ee dhangala'aa gaazii abbootii taayitaatti gorsanii akka turan kan ibsame yoo ta'u, amma gareen fayyisuu miidhaawwan biroo ittisuuf qophiirra jiru.

title: Powerful storm brings flooding, power outages to northeastern United States
english: A severe storm has struck the northeastern United States, causing widespread flooding, significant power outages, and the cancellation of hundreds of flights. State officials have declared emergencies and are urging citizens to avoid dangerous water conditions as high winds and heavy rain continue. While nor'easters are common in the region, this event is occurring earlier in the season than typically expected.
amharic: ኃይለኛ አውሎ ንፋስ በአሜሪካ ሰሜን ምስራቅ አካባቢዎች ከፍተኛ ጎርፍ እና የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ አስከትሏል። በዚህ ምክንያት በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ በረራዎች ተሰርዘዋል፣ ባለስልጣናትም የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ በማወጅ ህብረተሰቡ ከውሃ አካባቢዎች እንዲርቅ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ምንም እንኳን እንደዚህ አይነት አውሎ ንፋስ በዚህ ወቅት የተለመደ ቢሆንም፣ የዘንድሮው ከወትሮው ቀደም ብሎ በመከሰቱ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Obomboleettiin cimaan tokko naannoo kaaba-bahaa Yuunaayitid Isteetisitti mudatee lolaa cimaa fi humna ibsaa hir’achuu hordofsiiseera. Hojiin balallii xiyyaaraa dhibbaan lakkaa’amu addaan kan cite yoo ta’u, abbootiin taayitaa labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa labsuun namootni qarqara bishaanii fi bakka lolaan jiru irraa akka fagaatan akeekkachiisaniiru. Obomboleettiin akkanaa yeroo kana naannichatti kan barame ta’us, kan bara kanaa yeroo baramaa dursee dhufuun isaa yaaddoo uumee jira.

title: Deadly shooting hits Caribbean islands of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
english: A violent shooting in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines has left four people dead and four others injured near the capital, Kingstown. Police believe the attack was linked to ongoing gang retaliations, though no suspects have been arrested yet. Authorities are now increasing security patrols and urging the youth to avoid criminal activities to ensure public safety in this popular tourism destination.
amharic: በቅዱስ ቪንሰንት እና ግሬናዲንስ ዋና ከተማ ኪንግስቲን አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመ የሽጉጥ ጥቃት አራት ሰዎች ሲገደሉ አራት ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ፖሊስ ጥቃቱ በቡድኖች መካከል ከሚፈጠር ግጭት ጋር የተያያዘ እንደሆነ ቢጠረጥርም እስካሁን ምንም አይነት እስር አልተፈጸመም። መንግስት የጸጥታ ጥበቃን ያጠናከረ ሲሆን ወጣቶች ከወንጀል ድርጊቶች እንዲርቁ ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Saint Vincent fi Grenadines magaalaa guddoo Kingstown jedhamtu biratti dhukaasa banameen namoonni afur du'anii kan biroon afur immoo madaa'aniiru. Poolisiin haleellaan kun walitti bu'iinsa garee yakkaa waliin walqabata jedhee kan amanu yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti nama shakkame tokko illee hin qabne. Aangawaanni biyyattii nageenya naannichaa cimsuuf tarkaanfii fudhachaa jiran yoo ta'u, dargaggoonni yakka irraa akka fagaatan dhaamaniiru.

title: Israel's attorney general orders postponement of E1 settlement tender
english: Israel's attorney general has delayed a bidding process for new housing units in the E1 West Bank settlement by one month to keep it out of the national election campaigns. This project, which involves over 1,200 homes, has drawn international concern because it could block movement between Palestinian areas and damage the possibility of a two-state solution. Critics also point out that the plan threatens regional stability and comes during a period of rising violence.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ አቃቤ ህግ በምዕራብ ባንክ የሚገኘው የኢ-1 ሰፈራ ግንባታ ጨረታ ከምርጫ ዘመቻ ጋር እንዳይገናኝ የአንድ ወር እገዳ ጥሏል። ከ1,200 በላይ ቤቶችን ያካተተው ይህ ፕሮጀክት በፍልስጤማውያን መካከል ያለውን የትራንስፖርት እንቅስቃሴ የሚያስተጓጉል በመሆኑ በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። ይህም የሁለት ሀገር የመፍትሄ ሃሳብን የሚጎዳ እና በክልሉ ያለውን አለመረጋጋት የሚያባብስ መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa Israa'el sagantaa ijaarsa manneen jireenyaa naannoo E1 kan Qarqara Dhihaatti (West Bank) guyyoota 30f akka tursiisu ajajeera; kunis dhimmichi duula filannoo keessatti akka hin fayyadamneef kan godhame dha. Manneen jireenyaa 1,200 ol of keessatti qabatu kun, sochii ummata Falasxiin kan gufachiisuu fi furmaata biyyoota lamaa kan miidhu waan ta'eef gadda addunyaa kaaseera. Karoorri kun nageenya naannichaa kan boorreesuu fi walitti bu'iinsa dabaluu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama.

title: Settlers smash cars, damage ambulance in West Bank village
english: Israeli settlers raided the West Bank village of al-Mughayyir, damaging vehicles and an ambulance while stealing farm equipment. Witnesses and reports state that these attacks occurred while Israeli security forces remained present and provided protection to the attackers. During the incident, soldiers also searched homes, fired tear gas, and temporarily held local residents at the village entrance.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች በአል-ሙጋዪር መንደር በደረሱበት ጥቃት የሰዎችን መኪናዎች፣ አምቡላንስ እና የግብርና መሳሪያዎች አውድመዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በእስራኤል ወታደሮች ጥበቃ እና ፊት ለፊት መፈጸሙን የዓይን እማኞች ገልጸዋል። በዚሁ ወቅት ወታደሮቹ የአካባቢውን ነዋሪዎች ቤቶች በመበርበር እና እንባ አፋሽ ጋዝ በመተኮስ በዜጎች ላይ እንግልት ፈጽመዋል።
oromo: Warra biyya Israa'el kan ta'an kanneen qubatanii jiran ganda Al-Mughayyir jedhamu keessatti konkolaattota, ambulaansii fi meeshaalee qonnaa mancaasanii jiru. Miidhaan kun kan raawwatame poolisoonni Israa'el achuma jiranuun eegumsa gochaa akka turan gabaasni ni mul'isa. Yeroo kana keessa, loltoonni Israa'el mana jireenyaa sakatta'uudhaan, gaazii imimmaansuu darbachuudhaan fi namoota nagaa yeroodhaaf qabuudhaan miidhaa geessisanii jiru.

title: Musician Rob Del Naja arrested for 'I support Palestine Action' message
english: Massive Attack musician Rob Del Naja was arrested by UK police outside the Labour Party Conference for displaying a sign in support of Palestine Action. Authorities took this action because the government recently labeled the group a terrorist organization under national security laws. Del Naja rejected the legitimacy of the charges, while supporters have criticized the arrest and pledged to hold further demonstrations in his honor.
amharic: የማሲቭ አታክ የሙዚቃ ቡድን አባል የሆነው ሮብ ዴል ናጃ በሊቨርፑል በተካሄደው የሌበር ፓርቲ ጉባኤ ላይ ፍልስጤምን የሚደግፍ ምልክት በመያዙ በፖሊስ ተይዟል። የብሪታንያ መንግሥት 'ፓለስታይን አክሽን' የተባለውን ቡድን በአሸባሪነት በመፈረጁ፣ የሙዚቃ ባለሙያው በሽብርተኝነት ህግ ተከሷል። ዴል ናጃ የቀረበበትን ክስ እንደማይቀበል የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ ደጋፊዎቹ ይህንን እስር በመቃወም ተጨማሪ ሰልፎችን እንደሚያደርጉ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Artistii garee Massive Attack kan ta'e Rob Del Naja, magaalaa Liverpoolitti walga'ii Paartii Labour irratti mallattoo deeggarsa Palestine Action qabatee argamuun isaa poolisiin UK'n qabame. Mootummaan UK garee kana seera shororkeessummaan waan ramadeef, artistichi seeruma kanaan himatameera. Del Naja himata irratti dhiyaate kan hin fudhanne ta'uu ibsee, gartuun isaa immoo tarkaanfii kana balaaleffachuun guyyoota dhufanitti hiriira biroo akka taasisan ibsaniiru.

title: Israeli strike injures several displaced people in Gaza
english: An Israeli air strike targeted a tent sheltering displaced individuals in the Sheikh Radwan area of northern Gaza City. Multiple people sustained injuries as a result of the attack. Reports of the incident have been confirmed by local media sources.
amharic: የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት በሰሜን ጋዛ ከተማ በሚገኘው የሼክ ረድዋን ሰፈር ተፈናቃዮች ተጠልለውበት በነበረ ድንኳን ላይ ተፈጽሟል። በዚህ ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የአካባቢው መገናኛ ብዙኃን እንደዘገቡት የጥቃቱ ሁኔታ በምስል እና በቪዲዮ መረጃ ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Humni qilleensa Israa'el magaalaa Gaazaa kaabaa ganda Sheikh Radwaanitti bakka buqqaatonni keessa jiraatan reebdee jirti. Miidhaa qaqqabe kanaan namoonni hedduun madaa'aniiru. Gabaasni miidiyaaleen naannichaa akka ibsanitti, rakkoon kun namoota heddutti miidhaa geessiseera.
